a little about me_

I'm Anthony Li, a computer science student at the University of Toronto. I like taking things apart, understanding the pieces, and building something of my own.

based in
Toronto, Canada
interested in
machine learning, algorithms, game development
usually found
building something from scratch

what i've been working on

I led software development for CanSat, bringing computer vision, sensor processing, and mission software together under tight hardware constraints. That included adapting a graph neural network for aerial 3D reconstruction and Raspberry Pi inference.

I also led a 12-person team building Mayhem, a multiplayer game with over 200 players. More recently, I've been exploring compact AI text detectors as an independent CS229 project.
